mapper.select: select cra.es_id as id, cra.customer_id as customerId, su.name as employeeName, cra.begin_time as beginTime, cra.end_time as endTime, cra.is_connected as isConnected, cra.duration, mf.id as mediaFileId, mf.file_name as mediaFileName from mmba_call_record_audit cra left join sys_user su on su.um = cra.um left join mmba_media_file mf on mf.id = ( select m1.id from mmba_media_file m1 where m1.audit_record_id = cra.es_id and m1.behavior_type = 10 and m1.download_status = 'SUCCESS' order by m1.update_time desc limit 1 ) where cra.customer_id = #{request.sourceId} order by cra.begin_timestamp desc, cra.timestamp desc, cra.es_id desc
